purpose: Explicit opt-out of OpenClaw's automatic Gateway startup triage: with OPENCLAW_STARTUP_TRIAGE=off, triageAfterFailure returns before any triage process, managed-handoff claim, embedded repair turn or external coding agent (claude -p, codex) for a gateway-startup failure. Update-failure triage and every other path are unchanged; without the variable the original code runs. Set by gateway-start.sh only once this set is applied and verified.

replacements:

	if (process.env.OPENCLAW_SHELL === "exec" || process.env.CODEX_THREAD_ID || isGatewayExternallySupervised() || signal?.aborted) return;
